name: onoes-agent
description: Onoes-Agent V1.1 modular TypeScript product with Companion, Builder, and Kitchen Sink profiles

scripts.test: node scripts/bootstrap-audit-source.mjs && npm run test:compile && node --test --test-concurrency=4 .test-dist/tests/**/*.test.js
scripts.test:compile: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.test-dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.prelive:verify: npm run validate && npm run typecheck && npm run profile:audits && npm run live:dry-rehearsal && npm run live:report && npm run live:final-handoff-packet && git diff --check
scripts.validate: npm run build && npm test && npm run replay
scripts.dashboard:verify: npm run validate && npm run typecheck && npm run dashboard:readiness && git diff --check
scripts.package:compile: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.release.json
scripts.package:build: npm run package:compile && npm run test:compile && node .test-dist/src/bootstrap/run-package-build.js
scripts.v1-1:verify: npm run validate && npm run typecheck && npm run profile:audits && npm run live:dry-rehearsal && npm run live:report && npm run live:final-handoff-packet && npm run v1-1:release-audit && git diff --check
scripts.rust:shadow:supervisor: cargo build --manifest-path rust-shadow/Cargo.toml --locked --offline && node scripts/verify-rust-shadow-supervisor.mjs && node scripts/verify-rust-attested-shadow.mjs
scripts.rust:shadow:composition: npm run package:compile && cargo build --manifest-path rust-shadow/Cargo.toml --release --locked --offline && node scripts/verify-rust-shadow-composition.mjs
scripts.rust:shadow:manifest-compare: npm run package:compile && cargo build --manifest-path rust-shadow/Cargo.toml --release --locked --offline && node scripts/verify-rust-attested-manifests.mjs
scripts.rust:shadow:event-compare: npm run package:compile && cargo build --manifest-path rust-shadow/Cargo.toml --release --locked --offline && node scripts/verify-rust-attested-events.mjs
scripts.rust:shadow:evidence: npm run package:compile && cargo build --manifest-path rust-shadow/Cargo.toml --release --locked --offline && node scripts/build-rust-shadow-evidence.mjs && node scripts/verify-rust-shadow-evidence.mjs && node scripts/audit-rust-shadow-evidence.mjs
scripts.rust:shadow:verify: npm run rust:shadow:fmt && npm run rust:shadow:clippy && npm run rust:shadow:test && npm run rust:shadow:audit && npm run rust:shadow:supervisor && npm run rust:shadow:composition && npm run rust:shadow:manifest-compare && npm run rust:shadow:event-compare && npm run rust:shadow:differential
scripts.hybrid:verify: npm run v1-1:verify && npm run hybrid:supervisor:test && npm run rust:shadow:verify && git diff --check
scripts.ci:audit: npm run ci:workflow-audit && npm run ci:source-audit && npm run ci:license-audit
